title: Hydra — parameters.yaml
description: Parameters of a Hydra project: type, default value, required. Values per environment go in environments/<env>.yaml. Use a parameter as {{ param:NAME }} in any field, or params["NAME"] in a script. Managed by `hdrctl param` and Studio › Project settings › Parameters.

parameters.description: One entry per parameter. The name is what you write in {{ param:NAME }}.

propertyNames.errorMessage: Parameter names use letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

type.description: Type the value is converted to before the run. 'json' accepts a list or a mapping.

default.description: Value used when the active environment (environments/<env>.yaml) and -P give none.

required.description: true: the run fails if the parameter ends up with no value.

description.description: Shown in Studio and in `hdrctl param list`.
